data: Which line (green or red) shows a more dramatic increase in game score after 100 Monte-Carlo rollouts?

The green line represents the full model's performance, while the red line represents the text-unaware latent-variable model's performance. The caption states that the full model's performance improves dramatically over a small number of roll-outs, which is demonstrated by its significant increase in game score compared to the latent variable model. After 100 Monte-Carlo rollouts, the green line (full model) shows a more dramatic increase in game score than the red line (latent variable model).
